name: Dubai
summary: Split Dubai into creek heritage, Downtown and one coast or desert-side outing. Distances and heat make neighbourhood grouping more useful than trying to tick off landmarks in list order.
seasonNote: Cooler months suit outdoor walking. In summer, heat changes the practical itinerary; move exposed activities to early morning or evening.
arrival: Dubai International Airport has metro access from selected terminals. Check terminal and hotel location before choosing a transfer.
gettingAround: Combine Dubai Metro, walking within a district and taxis for dispersed attractions. Use the RTA journey planner for actual connections.
cashTip: Cards are widespread; keep dirhams for small shops, abra fares and tips when you choose to give them.
foodTip: Emirati, South Asian and seafood dining are all part of Dubai. Check specific halal and vegetarian evidence rather than assuming every venue has certification.
buyTip: Compare gold weight, purity, making charges and total price before buying; souks also offer spices and textiles.
baseArea: Bur Dubai for heritage and value; Downtown for landmark proximity; Marina for beach-focused stays.
